name: MLB Home Run Derby VR
detailed_description:
GO BIG in MLB’s Home Run Derby VR! 

Welcome to the only officially licensed Major League Baseball game in VR!  Swing for the fences with every team and every ballpark in stunning virtual reality, right here and no place else.

Step up to the Plate and Experience the Thrill of a Real Home Run Derby:

  • Visceral Gameplay: Feel the crack of the bat and hear the roar of the crowd like never before!  Realistic physics and intuitive motion controls make every swing feel like the final round of the Derby.

  • Stunning Stadiums: Crush towering home runs in authentically rendered stadiums, bathed in the vibrant lights and electric atmosphere of the big leagues.

  • Be the Best: Compete against the clock or go live against other players as you climb the leaderboards to become the ultimate Home Run Derby champion.  

  • Challenge Your Skills: You’ll need power and timing to tag multipliers and maintain an elite hot streak to rack up massive scores while you blast dinger after dinger.

  • Play Your Way: Whether you're a seasoned pro or a rookie hitter, Home Run Derby VR offers adjustable difficulty settings to challenge your skill level and hone your performance.

  • Progression & Customization Options: Advance through a deep progression system, unlocking unique bats, gloves, trophies and more.

  • Build a Legacy:   Decorate your custom clubhouse with earned items, and host other players, allowing you to showcase your unique style.  Watch the latest MLB news and highlights on the big screen from the best seat in the house!

  • Welcome to the Big Show: An all-new first-time user experience for the 2025 season makes sure you’re set up for success in your Derby career!

More Than Just a Game, it's a Major League Baseball Experience:

Home Run Derby VR puts you in the heart of baseball's most electrifying contest. Step into the batter's box, grip your virtual bat and unleash your inner slugger in a stunning, immersive VR experience.

Download Home Run Derby VR today and become a legend!

reviews:
“MLB Home Run Derby VR lets you launch dingers from your house”
Polygon

“Players will look to drive the ball out of the ballpark, and gain extra points for hitting targets in the stands”
Forbes

“The game will put you at the plate in three different MLB stadiums -- Marlins Park in Miami, Nationals Park in Washington, DC and Progressive Field in Cleveland -- to hit as many home runs as you can.”
Engadget
